ranking_method.scale_rule: Every positive and penalty component is an integer from 1 to 5. For positive components, 1 is weakest and 5 strongest. For ambiguity and review burden, 1 is lowest penalty and 5 highest penalty.

component_definitions.utility_score: 1 peripheral/limited practical use; 3 useful in recurring but bounded situations; 5 very frequent, broad everyday usefulness.
component_definitions.current_support_score: 1 little/no usable repository evidence; 3 one meaningful surface or repeated weak evidence; 5 strong repeated support across cards, teaching, drills or scenarios.
component_definitions.beginner_value_score: 1 mainly specialized/later B1 value; 3 useful A2-B1 value; 5 foundational A1-A2 value.
component_definitions.learning_payoff_score: 1 translation already supplies most needed guidance; 3 moderate non-obvious relationship; 5 high-error/non-obvious pattern that translation alone does not teach.
component_definitions.determinism_score: 1 difficult to test safely even with ordinary context; 3 deterministic with strong context/controlled options; 5 straightforward closed-answer practice.
component_definitions.context_reuse_score: 1 little/no natural current reuse; 3 one or a few reusable contexts; 5 repeated natural reuse across topics/scenarios.
component_definitions.contrast_value_score: 1 limited comparison value; 3 useful contrast; 5 strong high-value distinction from English or a nearby Polish construction.
component_definitions.ambiguity_score: Penalty: 1 low ambiguity/closed meaning; 3 material ambiguity needing context; 5 very high ambiguity or several equally natural analyses/answers.
component_definitions.review_burden_score: Penalty: 1 low burden with strong aligned evidence; 3 material meaning/register/construction questions; 5 high contemporary/native-review uncertainty.
